targetedRecheck.reason: Story 320 and Charme/Mojito mobile focal refinements; Home Light 600–760 px scrim contrast fix

observations: Live copy overlaps the full image on every mobile banner; faces remain above the copy and readable.
Home 320 retains both faces. Story 320 deliberately uses the right-hand pair; the man’s full head is retained after the targeted focal fix.
All six product campaign images retain exactly one person and recognizable product identity. Longest title wraps cleanly at 320 px.
Every Light/Dark 390 px crop was individually inspected. Cream text, small eyebrows and CTAs remain readable.
At 760 px Home and Story remain overlaid; desktop Home/Story/product baseline dimensions and appearance remain unchanged.
resolvedFindings: Story 320 outer head edge crop: corrected with 85% horizontal focus at <=340 px.
Home Light 760 eyebrow contrast: corrected with stronger scrim only from 600–760 px.
additionalRefinements: Charme mobile horizontal focus 75%; Mojito 77%, improving head/product margins.

contrast.method: minimum of foreground contrast against every actual background pixel in the text Range bounding rectangle, captured with only eyebrow visibility hidden and layout unchanged
